notes: hybrid=True, rerank=False, chunk_size=768, overlap=64; ground truth is document-level so the set survives re-chunking. SENSITIVITY: this is a 6-document corpus scored at k=5, so a retriever returns five of six documents and recall@5 is close to free — it detects retrieval being broken, not retrieval being slightly worse. MRR carries the real signal here: 1.0 means the correct document ranked FIRST for all 12 answerable queries, which a degraded retriever would lose. Treat this as a smoke gate; a discriminating baseline needs a larger fixture (TASK-0142).
